title: Mormon Tabernacle, Salt Lake City, from Robert N. Dennis collection of stereoscopic views 2
blurb: The foundation stones of the Salt Lake Temple are in the foreground, rising about 8 feet above ground level. The east end of the Salt Lake Tabernacle (1867) is the structure to the rear, with snow clinging to the top and lip of its domed roof. To the south (left) of the dome is the chimney and roof of the Old Salt Lake Tabernacle (1852) (aka the Adobe Tabernacle) which was razed in 1877. All of these buildings are on Temple Square, a complex located in the center of Salt Lake City, owned by The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
cond: Rectified 2026. Halves registered to 0.15% vertical error and 0.01° of rotation. Depth measured gentle (0.84% of frame width); hung in the VR Parlor at full size.
